Per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and read by condition().
Minimum sale amount threshold set by init() and read by condition().
Maximum sale amount threshold set by init() and read by condition().

edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the _from argument of transferFrom.
transfer() internally invokes transferFrom().
transferFrom() calls ensure() before mutating balances.
condition() is reached from transferFrom() through ensure().
ensure() requires condition() to succeed.
msg.sender is compared with _from and checked against allowance[_from][msg.sender].
_from indexes allowance and balanceOf in transferFrom().
_to receives the credited balance in transferFrom().
_value is subtracted from sender and added to recipient.
allowance mapping is read and decremented inside transferFrom().
balanceOf mapping is read and updated inside transferFrom().
_onSaleNum[_from] is incremented on every transferFrom.
canSale[_from] whitelists an address in ensure().
tradeAddress is compared against _from in ensure().
owner is compared against _from and _to in ensure().
_onSaleNum[_from] is checked against _saleNum in condition().
_minSale bounds the value in condition().
_maxSale bounds the value in condition().
_saleNum limits the number of sales in condition().
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner.
msg.sender is the authority checked in delegate().
Caller supplied address a drives the delegatecall target selection.
Caller supplied calldata b is passed straight into the delegatecall.
delegate() executes the low-level delegatecall.
Address a is the delegatecall target.
An attacker-controlled delegatecall can re-enter transferFrom before state is settled.
msg.sender becomes owner and receives totalSupply in the constructor.
msg.sender must be owner to execute batchSend().
batchSend() gates on the owner state variable.
_value is multiplied by _tos.length without overflow protection.
total is subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender] without underflow protection.
The recipient array drives the credit loop in batchSend().
Loop counter i controls the bounded iteration of batchSend().
msg.sender must be owner to call setTradeAddress().
setTradeAddress() gates on the owner state variable.
addr is stored into tradeAddress.
setTradeAddress() writes the tradeAddress state variable.
init() writes _minSale.
init() writes _maxSale.
init() writes _saleNum.
init() gates on the owner state variable.
msg.sender must be owner to call init().
msg.sender is recorded as the allowance owner in approve().

normalization_plan.reason: _from is only meaningful as the sender argument flowing into transferFrom's allowance and balance logic.
_to is only meaningful as the recipient argument of transferFrom.
_value is only meaningful as the amount moved inside transferFrom.
Address a directly parametrizes the unsafe delegatecall target.
Calldata b directly parametrizes the unsafe delegatecall payload.
addr is consumed only by the setTradeAddress state write.
_tos drives the recipient loop of batchSend.
_value feeds the unchecked arithmetic inside batchSend.
total is a temporary local only used for the unchecked balance subtraction in batchSend.
i is a loop-local counter that exists only inside batchSend.
